title: DotR config.toml
description: Configuration file for DotR (https://dotr.utsob.me/), a dotfiles manager.

banner.description: Print the DotR ASCII banner on commands. Set false for quiet output.

symlink.description: Deploy every directory package as a symlink, without setting symlink = true on each one individually. A package's own `symlink` field always overrides this, in either direction.

variables.description: Config-level variables, available to all templates, packages, and actions.

prompts.description: Config-level prompts: maps a variable name to the message shown when prompting for it.

bitwarden_note.description: Name of the Bitwarden secure note used when prompt_backend = "bitwarden". Every bitwarden-backed variable in the repository shares this one note; it's created automatically the first time it's needed if it doesn't already exist.

prompt_backend.description: Repo-wide default backend for every prompt. A profile's own prompt_backend overrides this when that profile is active.

packages.description: Package definitions, keyed by package name.

profiles.description: Profile definitions, keyed by profile name. A `default` profile always exists.

platforms.description: Platform definitions, keyed by platform name (e.g. "macos", "linux") - the same names used by a profile's `platform` field. A profile whose `platform` matches one of these keys picks up its variables.

src.description: Path to the file/directory in the repository.

dest.description: Deployment destination. `~` and template variables are expanded.

dependencies.description: Other packages deployed alongside this one whenever this package is selected.

variables.description: Package-scoped variables. Override platform, config-level, and environment variables of the same name; overridden in turn by profile variables of the same name.

pre_actions.description: Shell commands run before this package is deployed, in order.

post_actions.description: Shell commands run after this package is deployed, in order.

targets.description: Per-profile destination override: maps a profile name to a destination path used instead of `dest` when that profile is active.

skip.description: Exclude this package from profile-driven (implicit) selection. It's still deployed if named explicitly with --packages.

prompts.description: Package-scoped prompts: maps a variable name to the message shown when prompting for it.

ignore.description: Glob patterns (relative to `src`) excluded from deployment and cleaning. A non-empty list implies `unfold_symlink`, since an ignored path has nowhere real to live under a single whole-directory symlink.

symlink.description: Deploy this package as a symlink instead of a copy. An explicit true/false here always overrides the top-level `symlink` setting, in either direction; leave unset to follow it.

unfold_symlink.description: Symlink individual files instead of the whole directory, so untracked, unmanaged content can coexist at `dest`. Only meaningful when this package is deployed as a symlink.

clean.description: Remove files at the destination that no longer exist in the source. Set false to leave extra files alone.

dependencies.description: Packages deployed when this profile is active and no --packages is given.

variables.description: Profile-scoped variables. Override package, platform, config-level, and environment variables of the same name.

prompts.description: Profile-scoped prompts: maps a variable name to the message shown when prompting for it.

prompt_backend.description: Default backend for this profile's prompts. Overrides the top-level prompt_backend when this profile is active.

bitwarden_note.description: Overrides the top-level bitwarden_note when this profile is active.

platform.description: Names an entry in the top-level `platforms` table. Shares that platform's variables with every other profile that sets the same value, and shares a package's per-profile `targets` destination the same way. A `targets` entry keyed by this profile's own name still takes precedence over one keyed by its platform, and this profile's own `variables` still take precedence over the platform's.

variables.description: Variables shared by every profile whose `platform` field names this platform. Override config-level and environment variables, but are overridden by package and profile variables of the same name.

promptBackend.description: file: .uservariables.toml (default). keychain: the OS keychain, namespaced per-repository. bitwarden: a single shared Bitwarden secure note - see the top-level bitwarden_note setting.
